svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Recommendations A: Review queue
svg.desc: Recommendations workspace, alternative A: one recommendation at a time. A queue strip shows every recommendation of round 1 as a numbered disc by rule and state; the open card shows the part, the move, three facts that explain why, Apply / Other location / Keep in place / Manual move, and aisle G with the bin lifted to its best location.
svg.text: Run 2026-11-11 09:42 by Justas · 19 recommendations · 31 no space
